$comment: The schedule (UTC) of the GET cron routes, each called with the CRON_SECRET bearer. No host reads this file: thakeen.com runs these as hPanel cron jobs, entered by hand, and this list is what they must match (rule 989, docs/system/architecture.md 2.6). Reem's tick, POST /api/cron/secretary every 15 minutes, is not a GET cron and is described apart there. It was vercel.json, read by Vercel Cron, until 2026-10-10.
